_doc: Operator-provided ground truth (2026-07-08) — NOT regenerable, keep committed.
p1_side_set1: which side of the camera P1 (score key A) stands on in set 1.
Sides swap after EVERY set, so set k (0-based) side = p1_side_set1 flipped k times.
set5_swap_at_5: whether players ALSO swapped mid-set-5 when one side reached 5
points (optional in these friendly matches); null = match had no 5th set.
Going forward the operator convention is P1 = near player in set 1 (plan section 3.2).
